title: The Inventory Value report leaves out an untracked part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two parts for this test: part A, active and tracked, with 4 in its bin at a cost of $10.00, and part B, active and untracked, with 3 in its bin at a cost of $20.00.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.
custom_steps:
1. Pick the test location only in the Location filter.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the report's Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 2:

  • Exactly one row is listed: part A, with Qty 4.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost $40.00 (4 × $10.00 = $40.00).
  • There is no row for part B.
  • The Totals row reads Qty 4.00 and Total Cost $40.00: part B's 3 × $20.00 = $60.00 is not added, so the total is $40.00, not $100.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R9: “The Inventory Value report does not include untracked parts.”
  • Feature Overview, Accounting: “The Inventory Value report leaves out untracked parts, because they keep no stock count to value. This is a report change only.”
